AutomaticCalibrationController

class AutomaticCalibrationController(view, camera_index, monitor_index, service=None)[source]

Bases: QObject

Controller of the automatic calibration.

The view shows a ChArUco board on the projection screen; this controller reads the camera, detects the board, estimates where the screen corners are in the camera image and saves them as CalibrationPoint.

Parameters:
viewAutomaticCalibrationView

The automatic calibration dialog.

camera_indexint

OpenCV index of the camera.

monitor_indexint

Index of the projection screen.

serviceCalibrationService | None, optional

Calibration service. Default is None, which creates a new CalibrationService.

Notes

Messages are sent through the signals so the view shows them. The window title is translated with QCoreApplication.translate in the "AutomaticCalibrationController" context, and messages with self.tr().

generate_board_pixmap()[source]

Create the ChArUco board image for the screen.

Returns:
QPixmap

Board with get_automatic_num_columns() by get_automatic_num_rows() squares, stretched to the available screen size.

Notes

The square size is the mean of the screen width per column and the screen height per row; the marker size is that value times get_automatic_multiplier(). The board is drawn at 100 px per square with get_automatic_margin() and resized with nearest neighbor interpolation.

run_auto_calibration()[source]

Detect the board in the camera and save the corners.

Notes

Keys in the OpenCV window:

  • S: close the window, wait 1 s, discard 5 buffered frames and detect the board on a clean frame; on success, show it as a sample (preview mode).

  • R: discard the sample and resume tracking.

  • ESC: save the sample corners (if any) and finish; without a sample, finish without saving.

The corners are saved as the screen’s top-right, top-left, bottom-right, bottom-left corners in the camera image. With is_automatic_mirror_mode(), the x coordinates become frame width - x, so the saved order is the same in the mirrored image. TODO(doc): the manual calibration saves the clicks as top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right; is the different order intended?

Errors are reported through msg_critical_signal; the camera is released and all OpenCV windows are closed at the end.
